# anthropic_rbac_group (Resource)

Manages an RBAC group in a Claude Enterprise organization. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

Groups provisioned through SCIM (`source_type = "scim"`) are read-only: they can be imported and read, but renaming, deleting or changing their membership through the API fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_rbac_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, 1 to 255 characters. Uniqueness is not enforced by the API.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Group id (`rbac_group_...`).
- `roles` (List of String) RBAC role ids assigned to the group (read-only). Null when the API reports the list as temporarily unavailable.
- `source_type` (String) How the group is managed: `direct` (API/console) or `scim`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_rbac_group.engineering rbac_group_01ExampleGroupId00000000
```
